loader: comm_taskgraph.loader.reference:loader
reference-base-path: taskcluster/kinds

# reference-tasks now uses gitignore style pattern matching via
# pathspec. See
reference-tasks:
    - "*"
    - "!ub22-arm64*"
    - "!ub24-arm64*"

tasks = config.pop("reference-tasks", None)

    config.update(sub_config)
    project = params["project"]

    if tasks is not None:
        spec = pathspec.PathSpec.from_lines("gitwildmatch", tasks)

        found_reference_tasks = []
        for task in inputs:
            matches = list(spec.match_files(_get_aliases(kind, task, project)))
            if matches:
                found_reference_tasks.append(task)

        return found_reference_tasks

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 583 makes reference-tasks use pathspec gitwildmatch against task aliases. The package kind starts with quoted "*", then quoted negations such as "!ub22-arm64*" and the newer "!ub24-arm64*". Quoting keeps YAML from treating these as syntax; starting with inclusion gives the exclusions an actual set to subtract from. Match aliases, not an assumed single task label. This is a manual pattern-order and configuration syntax contract beyond whitespace formatting.
title: Quote YAML wildcard and exclusion patterns and include the universe first
